$comment: Career card sleeves (CAREER_SLEEVES in progressModel.ts): card backs, drawn on card faces and deck boxes.
style: Trading card backs: one upright card back per cell, front view, perfectly flat and symmetrical, all exactly the same size and the same 5:7 rectangle with slightly rounded corners. The card's outline is a clean straight-edged rectangle: every ornament stays INSIDE it and nothing sticks out past its edges. A rich cloth or lacquer field in the given colour, a thin gilded ornamental border just inside the edge, and one central gilded emblem in a medallion. Each card fills about 90% of its cell's height.
spare: a plain dark green card back
